messages:
anna: Heads-up: two-stage FK validation + apply for payments.transactions -> accounts(id) tonight 23:00 UTC. Plan: dry-run validate on replicas, then short-lock apply on primary. Requesting deploybot pin to schema-v3.2.5 and region pin to global with canary only in us-east-1. Estimated 60-90m. Any blockers?
chris: Ack. What's the dry-run scope and sampling?
anna: Dry-run will validate full table but run as a low-priority background job that samples 1% initially, then ramps to 10% if no issues. We'll run constraint_check_job with --mode=dry-run --sample=1 then --sample=10.
mike: Suggest explicit abort thresholds: if validation error rate >0.1% in sample OR absolute failures >500 rows -> stop. During apply: p99 DB latency >400ms for 5m OR replica_lag>120s -> abort. Also if exclusive lock wait >3 for >3m.
anna: Agree. Add: if any foreign-key violations surface during the primary apply (shouldn't) -> immediate abort.
chris: Notes on locks: apply will use "ALTER TABLE ... ADD CONSTRAINT ... NOT VALID" then validate in batches to reduce lock time. Final validation will run with CONCURRENT VALIDATE and could acquire brief locks when swapping state.
anna: Example commands:
```bash
# dry-run validation (sample)
./constraint_check --table=payments.transactions --fk=accounts(id) --mode=dry-run --sample=1 --out=check_1789998888.json
# apply (two-stage)
deployctl pin --release-group fk-validate-payments --version schema-v3.2.5
psql -c "ALTER TABLE payments.transactions ADD CONSTRAINT fk_accounts_id FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES accounts(id) NOT VALID;"
# then in batches
./validate_batches --table=payments.transactions --constraint=fk_accounts_id --batch-size=200000
psql -c "ALTER TABLE payments.transactions VALIDATE CONSTRAINT fk_accounts_id;"
```
chris: If deploybot can't pin, fallback is to gate with feature flag 'fk_payments_enabled' and set to false. @mike volunteer to manual-unpin?
mike: I'll manual-unpin and toggle the flag if needed. I'll be on standby.
deploybot: Pin request accepted. Pinning schema-v3.2.5 for release-group 'fk-validate-payments' at 1789998888. Canary enabled in us-east-1 only. Emitting progress every 10m and alerting on configured thresholds.
sre-bot: Added monitoring hooks: DB p99, replica_lag, lock_waits. Will trigger paging policy on p99>400ms or replica_lag>120s.
opsbot: Drafted release note at release_notes/1789998888.md: "Two-stage FK add for payments.transactions -> accounts(id). Dry-run validation on replicas with sampling, then controlled apply on primary. Possible short exclusive locks during final validate step; abort criteria and rollback runbook in thread."
chris: Rollback runbook snippets:
```sql
-- emergency stop (mark controller)
UPDATE migration_control SET state='abort' WHERE name='fk-payments-1789998888';
-- remove constraint if partially applied
ALTER TABLE payments.transactions DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_accounts_id;
-- flip feature flag
UPDATE feature_flags SET enabled=false WHERE name='fk_payments_enabled';
-- unpin (cli)
deployctl pin --release-group fk-validate-payments --unpin
```
anna: Run order tonight: 23:00 start dry-run sample=1 for 15m, review; if green bump sample to 10 for 30m; then schedule primary apply at 00:15 UTC with final notify & 10m prep window.
mike: I'll be on pager for unpin and rollback steps. I'll also coordinate with infra to pause heavy analytics jobs during the primary apply window.
chris: Will run smoke queries and a small synthetic load to validate API error rates before applying. Abort if API error rate >0.3% during health checks.
anna: OK launching dry-run sample=1 at 23:00. I'll post 15m status pings. Deploybot: please post pin confirmation and any automated alerts to this thread.
deploybot: Pin confirmed. schema-v3.2.5 pinned for fk-validate-payments. Dry-run job started for sample=1. Progress updates every 10m.
opsbot: Reminder: please add a short line in the public release notes if we make this change to mention potential short read spikes.
